prompt_md: A chocolate bar is a 4 by 6 grid of squares. Each break snaps one piece into two along a groove. How many breaks does it take to get 24 single squares?
prompt_short: 4 by 6 chocolate bar, one piece per break. Breaks to get 24 squares?
hint_md: What does every single break do to the number of pieces?
explain_intuition_md: Each break turns one piece into two, so it adds exactly one piece. Going from 1 piece to 24 takes 23 breaks, in any order. Counting 3 + 5 grooves would only work if one snap could split every piece at once.
